The room feels different when you're in it. Warmer. Lighter. Like the whole world exhales. That's you — that's what you do.

I look at you and I see my safe place. My greatest adventure. My favorite person in a world full of people. Loving you is the easiest thing I have ever done, and I would choose you, in every version of every life.

and it is still happening.

Forever Yours

💕

To my dearest… ❤️

Happy Birthday to the most beautiful and precious girl in the whole world! We both know best just how important and meaningful today is for the two of us. Today is not only your birthday, but it is also the special day I confessed my feelings to you and made the rightest, happiest decision of my life. Thank you so much for coming into my life and always filling it with love and bringing a smile to my face. Even though we are apart right now, I believe our hearts are always together. The more I miss you, the deeper my love for you grows. I will be by your side soon, and everything is going to be wonderful. ✨ Know that when we are together, we can overcome any hardship and create the happiest memories. I am counting down the days, eagerly waiting to be with you again. Make sure to fulfill all your wishes on your birthday and be the happiest girl today. I will love you endlessly and cherish you forever.

Happy Birthday, my precious treasure & my queen. 💗
